hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(js|html|css)$' || exit 0; [ -x "./node_modules/.bin/prettier" ] && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.js$' && [ -x "./node_modules/.bin/eslint" ] && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null; } 2>/dev/null || true
